name: Taming the Beast
label: Quest

intro: This trial marks the second stage of a tauren hunter's initiation into the art of beast taming. Guided by hunter trainer Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village, the novice is charged with mastering the swift and fearless prairie stalker.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have a fiery spirit, hunter, readily awaiting your next challenge.
Your next task is to gain the companionship of a wolf known as the prairie stalker. This creature is swift and fearless; in taking this beast as your pet, you must also take on these qualities.
During a battle, you will learn how you and your pet will become a team. In the end you must work as one, muscle to muscle.
Here is the taming rod, friend. Tame a prairie stalker and practice your skills.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found a prairie stalker?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes... The Earthmother believes that you are ready for the next lesson.
